item.title: Wilcox.test comparing values in one column based on their value in a different column?
item.description:
Not sure if the title makes sense! I want to do a wilcox.test to compare the adjusted mean based on the cohort number (cohort is set as a character and not a numerical value). Basically I want to know if there is a statistical significance between cohorts based on their adjusted\_mean values!!! Did I word that right? Been staring at this for an hour can someone help me with the code 😅🙏🏻 I have only ever used RStudio for graphs and not data analysis!
I am trying the following code but I can tell it isn't working because it isn't separating by cohort
\> wilcox.test(ALL\_PFC$adjusted\_mean, [data.name](http://data.name) = "cohort")
